// Command greeter is the fixture tool for wasmrt's integration test. It
// exercises every shape of the guest contract: JSON and text results, a
// handler that fails, a handler that panics, logging and progress.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/richardwooding/forge/sdk/tool"
)

type GreetArgs struct {
	Name  string `json:"name" jsonschema:"who to greet"`
	Times int    `json:"times,omitempty" jsonschema:"how many times"`
	Loud  bool   `json:"loud,omitempty" jsonschema:"shout it"`
}

type GreetResult struct {
	Greeting string `json:"greeting"`
	Length   int    `json:"length"`
}

type EchoArgs struct {
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

type BigArgs struct {
	N int64 `json:"n" jsonschema:"a number that must survive the round trip"`
}

type BigResult struct {
	N int64 `json:"n"`
}

var _ = tool.Register(
	tool.Spec{
		Name:    "greeter",
		Version: "1.0.0",
		Summary: "Greets people",
		Labels:  []string{"demo", "text"},
	},
	tool.Op("greet", greet, tool.Summary("Greet someone"), tool.ReadOnly()),
	tool.Op("echo", echo, tool.Text(), tool.Summary("Echo the input")),
	tool.Op("fail", fail, tool.Summary("Always fails")),
	tool.Op("boom", boom, tool.Summary("Always panics")),
	tool.Op("chatty", chatty, tool.Text(), tool.Summary("Logs and reports progress")),
	tool.Op("big", big, tool.Summary("Round-trips a large integer")),
)

func main() {}

func greet(ctx *tool.Context, a GreetArgs) (GreetResult, error) {
	if a.Times <= 0 {
		a.Times = 1
	}
	g := strings.TrimSpace(strings.Repeat("Hello, "+a.Name+"! ", a.Times))
	if a.Loud {
		g = strings.ToUpper(g)
	}
	return GreetResult{Greeting: g, Length: len(g)}, nil
}

func echo(ctx *tool.Context, a EchoArgs) (string, error) { return a.Text, nil }

func fail(ctx *tool.Context, a EchoArgs) (string, error) {
	return "", fmt.Errorf("this operation always fails: %s", a.Text)
}

func boom(ctx *tool.Context, a EchoArgs) (string, error) {
	panic("deliberate panic: " + a.Text)
}

func chatty(ctx *tool.Context, a EchoArgs) (string, error) {
	ctx.Infof("starting work on %q", a.Text)
	for i := 1; i <= 3; i++ {
		ctx.Progress(int64(i), 3, fmt.Sprintf("step %d", i))
	}
	ctx.Warnf("nearly done")
	fmt.Println("this went to stdout")
	return "done", nil
}

func big(ctx *tool.Context, a BigArgs) (BigResult, error) { return BigResult{N: a.N}, nil }
